topic.topic: Why the Moon’s phases don’t bring an eclipse every month
topic.angle: Explain how the Moon’s orbit tilt creates the familiar phase cycle while usually carrying the Moon above or below the Sun-Earth alignment needed for an eclipse; distinguish lunar from solar eclipses without relying on event-specific dates.

decisions.reason: NASA’s phase and eclipse pages support a clear evergreen explanation of why eclipses do not happen every month.
